facts.text: Accor Arena, once called Palais Omnisports de Paris‑Bercy, can seat between 7,000 and 20,300 people depending on the event.
During the 2024 Summer Olympics, Accor Arena hosted artistic and trampoline gymnastics before becoming the venue for basketball medal games.
Bercy Village grew from 12th‑century wine warehouses into a modern cultural hub that preserves historic stone storehouses.
For over a century, the former wine storerooms of Bercy hosted the world’s largest wine market.
The arena’s name changed from Bercy Arena to AccorHotels Arena in October 2015, then reverted to Bercy Arena in 2020 because of Olympic naming rules.
In January 2020, Accor Arena hosted an NBA regular‑season game where the Milwaukee Bucks faced the Charlotte Hornets, with French star Nicolas Batum playing.
